title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Koepka’s Season Finale Eagle
items.text: Brooks Koepka ended his PGA Tour season with a 40-foot eagle putt on the 18th hole at St. Andrews, finishing the Alfred Dunhill Links Championship with a final-round 66.

items.headline: Kim Withdraws From Baycurrent Classic
items.text: Tom Kim withdrew from the 2026 Baycurrent Classic in Yokohama after winning the Asian Games and receiving a military exemption; Kris Ventura replaced him in the 72-player field.

items.headline: DP World Tour Limits LIV Returnees
items.text: The DP World Tour announced strict conditions for LIV Golf players seeking to return after the tour’s bankruptcy.
